books.title: The Forgotten King
books.author: A. McQueen
books.description:
In a land lost to time, rests a kingdom with a forgotten name. A king, walks its halls and dines in the empty hall. His people have gone but he stays, protecting their homes and land in case they one day return.

Wandering, lost in the dark woods, a princess seeks shelter and safety as she flees her war-torn land in hopes to find aid to save her people.

Will their paths connect?
Will she save her people?
Will the king finally not be alone in his shadowed walls?
